keyImprovements: Identified the root cause of persistent noise: Codacy Cloud enforces 'Copy of Default coding standard' which locks incompatible plugins (es-x, @lwc, TSQLLint, Biome) at the organization level.
Disabled 5 incompatible and redundant static analysis tools (PMD, PMD7, TSQLLint, SQLint, SQLFluff) reducing pattern count from 5365 to 4455.
Tuned Lizard cyclomatic complexity thresholds to 20 to eliminate function length noise in React components.
Provided actionable recommendations for Codacy Cloud organization administrators to unlink or edit 'Copy of Default coding standard'.
